title: Gibson Premium Gig Bag, Small-Body Acoustic, Black

long_description.body:
Take your Gibson instrument with you in one of our Premium Gig Bags. They have a rugged polyester exterior and plush-lined interior to help keep your instrument safe and secure and come equipped with two external accessory compartments that are perfect for straps, picks, cables, and other essentials.





Black polyester exterior with a black plush interior




Padded handle for a comfortable grip




Second grab handle on the rear for easy maneuverability




Dual, concealable backpack straps




Internal dimensions: 40.0” length, 11.0” upper body width, 14.5" lower body width, 4.0” depth
